items.briefing:
Cyber attacks rose 16% in July, with ransomware driving much of the increase — a reminder that Australian organisations remain firmly in the crosshairs. Staff should stay alert to suspicious emails or unusual system behaviour, as ransomware typically enters through phishing or compromised credentials.

On a positive note, Quest has achieved IRAP status, meaning its products have been assessed as suitable for Australian government use — a useful benchmark when evaluating software vendors. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email asking you to click a link or open an attachment, verify the request directly with the sender before acting.

featured.title: Cyber attacks rise 16% as ransomware surges in July
featured.quote: Ransomware attacks surge 49% in July, signalling escalating threat to Australian organisations.
